_comment: The first voyage (tutorial_director.gd). Each step: station = where Silas stands (silas_cobb.gd), done = flags, any of which finishes the step (flags are set by the director's pollers, so doing things out of order still counts), lines = said when the step starts, early = said instead if it was already done, nudge = said in turn when nothing happens for nudge_after_s. Line ids are for the voice files later: res://assets/audio/voice/silas/<id>.ogg. {km} {kn} {kmh} {hours} are filled in live.

tips.text: In harbour, with every sail furled, the boats tow her at about a knot. You can't get stuck in port. Set a sail and you're the wind's again.
Aground. It happens. You can always turn her, even stuck fast: the crew pole the bow round. Swing her about and sail off the way you came.

lines.text: Paid in full, so she's yours. I'm only here to see she outlives the week.
Market's up the quay. Go ashore, speak to a stallholder, buy one box of something cheap.
You'll lose money on it either way. Think of it as tuition. I'll wait aboard, holding the boat.

early.text: Bought already. Good. Spending is the one skill nobody has to teach.

nudge.text: Stallholder. Walk up, click him. Press Buy. The coin is the easy part.
Still aboard? The quay is that way. Mind the gap.

lines.text: What you buy goes to the port box on the quay. Empty hands, click the box, carry it aboard.
Down in the hold, hold Space. Green means it fits. Red means it doesn't. I'd not have thought it needed saying.
E tips it, R turns it, click sets it down. Heavy cargo low and in the middle, or she rolls.

nudge.text: Port box, by the pier. Click it with empty hands and bring it aboard.
In the hold, hold Space and look for green. Click to set it down.

lines.text: To the tiller. She's a cutter; it's a stick, not a wheel.
Press E there to cast off. Lines off the rail, unless you plan to tow the pier to sea.

early.text: Already off the pier. I'd have said something, but you were quick.

nudge.text: At the tiller, press E. That's the whole instruction.

lines.text: Sails. Their lines run to the pins at the rail. Haul a line down to furl, ease it upward to set.
Let go and the pin holds it. Set her up and she'll draw.

early.text: Sails already up. Good. Cloth does nothing furled.

nudge.text: Click a sail line and ease it up. Then the cloth drops.

lines.text: Take the tiller. Wind behind you, she flies. Wind in your face, you're a very slow raft.
The windsock shows it. Keep the wind behind you and hold her there a while.

early.text: She's moving nicely. Don't let it go to your head.

nudge.text: Watch the windsock. Turn her until the wind is behind you.
Sails set? Tiller steady? Then it's just patience.

lines.text: Chart's on the cabin table. Click it. North's up, the gold diamond is where we're going.
Read the heading off the compass at the tiller and steer for the diamond. Q centres the tiller, Z holds your course.

early.text: On course already. Either you can read a chart or you're lucky.

nudge.text: Cabin table. Click the chart. The gold diamond is the port.
Bring her round until the compass agrees with the diamond. Within a few degrees will do.

lines.text: How fast are we going? You can guess, as most do, or measure it with the log line on the stern rail. Click the coil.
Count the blocks that run over the rail while the sand glass runs. Blocks are knots.

early.text: You've taken a reading already. A proper navigator.

nudge.text: Stern rail, the coil. Click it, and count the blocks until the sand runs out.

on_port_in_sight.text: There's the port, {km} kilometres off. No more sleeping: sail her in awake from here. I'll tell you when to start slowing.

on_slept.text: Awake at a marker. She stops at each one so you can turn her. Still {km} kilometres to go, about {hours} hours at this pace.
Another marker. Turn onto the new heading, check the sails are drawing, and back to bed. {km} kilometres left.

lines.text: Long way yet. Sums first. {km} kilometres to go, and we're making {kn} knots.
Knots times 1.852 is kilometres an hour. That's {kmh}. {km} over {kmh} comes to about {hours} hours.
Hold your course, check the sails are drawing, then click the bed. Type the hours, or ask for morning. She wakes you at each marker.

early.text: Land already? Then you slept, or you sailed it awake. Either way, no sums needed.

nudge.text: Bed's in the cabin. Click it, type the hours, press Enter.
She needs to be on course with sails drawing, or you'll wake up somewhere unlovely.

lines.text: Land. Now the hard part: stopping. Once you're in the harbour, haul every sail up. The boats tow her along at about a knot, so she can't stall. Dock under three knots.
Line her up with the light at the berth. Amber, then green. Press E to dock. Gently. She's older than you and she's earned it.

nudge.text: Slower. Furl a sail or two. Wait for the light to go green.
Light's green, speed's low? Press E.

lines.text: Fast to the pier. The gangway's out. Ashore, find a stallholder, and open his 'We buy'.
He buys from your hold. Sell the box. Buy cheap, sell dear, that's the whole trade. Mind you, today you'll lose a little. I did warn you.

early.text: Sold already. Look at you, a merchant.

nudge.text: Stallholder who deals in your goods. Click him, then We buy, then Sell.
Nothing to sell? It's still in the hold. Bring it up to the stallholder's side of the quay.

lines.text: One more thing. The shelf in the cabin. Every rope, sum and trick I've told you is written down there, and a few I didn't.
Click a book to read it. When you forget something, and you will, that's where to look.

early.text: You've found the books already. Good. Everything I've said is in there, written slower.

nudge.text: Cabin. The shelf. Click a book. They don't bite.
Anything white-outlined is yours to click. The shelf's outlined. Hint, hint.

lines.text: That's the lot: buy, stow, sail, steer, count, sleep, dock, sell. The rest is the sea's business.
She's yours. I'm told I'm retired. Esc for the menu when you've had enough of me.
